policy: Only equal-count original word/timestamp files with fully accounted non-increasing issues are eligible. For every adjacent a>=b, withhold every word window whose closed interval intersects [min(a,b),max(a,b)], including neighboring windows. Use cumulative original source-word counts, retain unsplit merged source words and leave final offsets null until the independent measured recording end. Never sort, interpolate, shift or replace any source timestamp. Refuse any requested span containing a withheld word.

limits: Structural correspondence and measured-duration containment only, not proof of acoustic word boundaries. Original Hebrew/accent strings, source words, issues, timestamps, raw null bounds and recording status are retained. Fixed source pronunciation, independent text styles, raw F0 approximation, musical grammars and singing voices remain distinct.
